usage.reason: The Canva REST API has no per-user last-active field, no audit or activity log, and no per-user usage report. Analytics endpoints cover views of individual designs only, require Canva Enterprise, and are preview APIs.

assumptions: The source documents no endpoint that lists all people in a Canva team or account. The only user endpoint, GET /v1/users/me, returns a single object (not a list), so it cannot be used as a record list.

To get a valid list, users are now derived from the owner.user_id of each design returned by GET /v1/designs. This only finds people who own designs visible to the authorising person, may repeat the same person several times, and will miss members who own no visible designs. It is not a full user directory.
Email, display name, status, role and user type are not available, so they are left empty.
The design list needs the design:meta:read scope; profile:read was kept from before and is unconfirmed as needed.
The page size of 100 is a guess; the source does not state a maximum for the limit parameter. The continuation cursor is taken from the response field 'continuation'.

Canva only offers user-delegated OAuth (authorization code with PKCE) for this API. No service account or client-credentials method is documented, so the connection depends on the authorising person staying in the company.
No usage signal exists in the source. Design analytics are Enterprise-only, per-design and preview, so usage is marked unavailable.
The source states no general request rate limit for these endpoints, so rate limit fields are left empty.
